caption: Read left to right: logs A and D run on the call stack, then promise callback C drains from the microtask queue, and only then does timer callback B run. C overtakes B even though setTimeout was called before the promise.

spec.aria: Timeline with three lanes: the call stack runs log A then log D, the microtask queue runs promise callback C, and the task queue runs timer callback B last, giving the order A, D, C, B.
